name: War Wagon
piloting: Driving Lore (DC 24) or Nature (DC 26 to DC 34 depending on the pulling creatures
speed: the Speed of the slowest pulling creature (pulled by 6 Large creatures)

items.name: Weapon Mounts
items.text: This vehicle has one weapon mount. At purchase, the weapon mount is initially empty. Installing or uninstalling a weapon into a mount requires 1 day, a successful DC 24 Crafting check check, and an appropriate weapon. This weapon mount can be equipped with a Large or smaller ranged siege weapon.

items.name: Countermeasures
items.text: A creature that Strikes a war wagon with a non-reach melee weapon or unarmed attack takes 3d8 piercing damage (DC 24 basic Reflex save save).

text: Often adorned with spikes and other defensive countermeasures, a war wagon is an intimidating sight on any battlefield. It can carry both soldiers and a siege weapon.
